response.text: I'll start by verifying the notes with set-based queries.

arguments.sql: select h.jrnl_no, sum(l.dr_amt) dr, sum(l.cr_amt) cr from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h.jrnl_no=l.jrnl_no group by h.jrnl_no having sum(l.dr_amt)<>sum(l.cr_amt)

select l.jrnl_no, l.ln_seq, l.acct_cd, l.dr_amt, l.cr_amt, c.acct_cd as coa, c.actv_flg from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on upper(trim(c.acct_cd))=upper(trim(l.acct_cd)) where c.acct_cd is null or c.actv_flg<>'Y'

select h.jrnl_no, h.prd_id, h.post_dt, p.strt_dt, p.end_dt, p.close_dt, p.stat_cd, h.src_cd, h.src_ref from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p.prd_id=h.prd_id where h.post_dt<p.strt_dt or h.post_dt>p.end_dt or (p.stat_cd='C' and h.post_dt>p.close_dt)

select i.inv_id, i.inv_no, i.vend_cd, i.inv_amt, i.jrnl_no, i.stat_cd, (select sum(cr_amt) from "GLJRNL" l where l.jrnl_no=i.jrnl_no and trim(l.acct_cd)='2000') cr2000, (select sum(dr_amt) from "GLJRNL" l where l.jrnl_no=i.jrnl_no and trim(l.acct_cd)<>'2000') drx, (select sum(dr_amt) from "GLJRNL" l where l.jrnl_no=i.jrnl_no and trim(l.acct_cd)='2000') dr2000 from "APINVH" i where not exists (select 1 from "GLJRNL" l where l.jrnl_no=i.jrnl_no and trim(l.acct_cd)='2000' and abs(l.cr_amt-i.inv_amt)<0.005) and i.inv_amt>0
